claim: Source-bundle coding reduces overclaiming relative to timeless civilization-level absence coding.
evidence_required: missingness audit; source-bundle coverage; counterexample analysis
failure_condition: bundle rules cannot be applied reproducibly or materially distort source coverage

claim: Presence-Jaccard is less vulnerable than simple matching to shared-absence inflation in sparse motif matrices.
failure_condition: metric choice does not materially affect sparse-data interpretation

claim: Positive motif overlap is associated with independently measured ancestry/contact/environment layers in distinguishable ways.
evidence_required: expanded case universe + preregistered dyadic models
failure_condition: sample/model gate not met or estimates too unstable

claim: Mechanism signatures differ across flood, anthropogony, and divine-conflict families.
failure_condition: insufficient analyzable dyads or no robust heterogeneity

claim: Mesopotamian-Hebrew flood similarity is better explained by a historically plausible literary-dependence family than by similarity score alone.
evidence_required: chronology + textual scholarship + independent contact opportunity + falsifiers
failure_condition: route chronology or source scholarship materially contradicts dependence family

claim: The current Chinese water-catastrophe bundle is structurally distinct from the Near Eastern ark-survival bundle.
evidence_required: expanded Chinese source sensitivity + translation sensitivity
failure_condition: predeclared alternative Chinese bundles erase the contrast

claim: QCA adds information beyond the dyadic/phylogenetic design.
evidence_required: set-valued outcome + defensible calibration + adequate independent cases
